release_notes: Fixed S3 release URI.
Implemented AWS S3 release step.

Implemented X003 as a circular-import rule (no longer reserved/disabled); projects carrying ignore = ["X003"] opt in by removing it. Added ModuleImport, ModuleLocation and ModuleImportGraph import-graph helpers.
New built-in X013: require subprocess.Popen and socket.socket to be used as context managers.
New built-in X014: enforce tracked TODO/FIXME comment metadata ([date][owner] slug [issue: #N, URL] - context).

Project-local rule_modules now load from the target project's config directory (resolve_registry() gains project_root, added to sys.path only while they import); --no-config loads no project rule modules.
flakeforge check <dir> now discovers config from the target path instead of the current directory; discovery_anchor() is exported for API callers.
flakeforge check now exits 2 with 'path does not exist' for a missing path argument instead of reporting 0 files and exiting 0.

Renamed the project from flake8-lint to flakeforge (package, CLI command, [tool.flakeforge] config section, flakeforge.rules entry-point group); [tool.flake8_lint] is accepted as a deprecated fallback and [tool.flake8_lint_tests] is retired.
Unknown config keys are now an error (exit 2) with a did-you-mean hint; the legacy [tool.flake8_lint] section stays lenient and only warns.
Absolute patterns in include, exclude, noqa_allowed and noqa_forbidden config values are now a config error (exit 2); relative patterns, including '..', remain supported.
Displayed file paths are now relative to the config file's directory (base_dir), identical from any working directory.
JSON output now carries "schema_version": 1; output formats are driven by a single flakeforge.api.FORMATTERS table.
New github (GitHub Actions ::error annotations) and sarif (SARIF 2.1.0 for code-scanning upload) output formats; LintResult gains an additive registered_rules field.
New --statistics / --no-statistics flag (TOML key statistics) adding a per-code count summary to text and json output; it never changes the exit code.
New flakeforge config show command printing the fully resolved configuration and the origin (default / file / cli) of every key, in text or json.
New flakeforge rules command listing every rule in the resolved registry with its description, provider origin and enabled state; RuleRegistration gains an additive origin field.
New flakeforge init [DIR] command writing a fully commented flakeforge.toml (or, with --pyproject, a [tool.flakeforge] table in pyproject.toml); it never overwrites an existing config.
New per_file_ignores config key and repeatable --per-file-ignores "GLOB:CODE[,CODE]" flag to skip rule codes for matching files.

New baseline support for incremental adoption: --write-baseline PATH records current violations and --baseline PATH (TOML key baseline) suppresses them so only new violations fail the run; entries that no longer match are reported as fixed.

New built-in X015 (enabled by default) reporting unused # noqa directives; it is emitted by the engine, is not suppressible by # noqa, and is never emitted by the Flake8 adapter. Opt out with ignore = ["X015"].

Internal: rules.py now holds only the built-in rule functions in code order; helpers moved to flakeforge.rule_helpers and registration to flakeforge.catalog. Import-graph helpers remain importable from flakeforge.rules. No rule behavior changes.
First stable release of flake8-lint: a standalone, reusable AST-based Python lint rule engine.
Ships four ways to run the same core: standalone CLI (flake8-lint check), Python API, a thin Flake8 plugin adapter, and an opt-in pytest helper (assert_lint_clean).

Built-in rules X001-X012 (X003 reserved/disabled), covering bare excepts, overly broad exceptions, muted exceptions, docstring requirements, local imports, missing/None return annotations, percent-formatting, import-error suppression, Optional usage, and union-type annotations.
Custom rule support via project-local rule modules and installed flake8_lint.rules entry points, with duplicate/invalid-code detection at registry resolution time.
Config discovery precedence: --config PATH > flake8_lint.toml > pyproject.toml [tool.flake8_lint] > legacy [tool.flake8_lint_tests] > defaults.
Engine-owned # noqa suppression semantics shared across all four integration surfaces.
CI verified on Python 3.11 through 3.14, including a wheel-smoke job exercising the built package end-to-end.
